title: 第九章 你就是最厉害的第十章 这真有毛病了
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
叶晚秋上了年纪之后觉少，天刚亮就起来了。
如果是以前，她得去菜市场买最新鲜的菜，准备一大家子人的早饭。
来到这地方之后，不需要去菜市场里和那一群老头老太太抢着买菜，也不用费心准备不同口味的早饭，她清闲下来反倒不知道要做什么了。
叶晚秋回想着孙子学的广播体操，喊着口号自己也做了一套。
这人心里没有什么事情后，果然是神清气爽的。
轻轻松松做完最后一个动作，汗都没出。
“好！”
院子外响起一道声音，叶晚秋吓一跳。
她转身看过去，发现是崔向阳。
“叶婆婆，我觉得你真该去测测灵根，说不定有修炼天赋呢，这身子骨，比山下那些人好太多了。”崔向阳说道。
他练出了清明丸，心情那叫一个好。
想拿着丹药去丹修长老那里嘚瑟，结果人不在，估计是去其他地方寻药了。
本想回去补补觉，走着走着就来到了叶晚秋住的小院子。
这来都来了，怎么能不吃顿饭再回去？
叶晚秋不好意思笑笑：“我就是平时喜欢跳跳广场舞，比普通人精神好一点，要是让我练剑……”
她在脑海里想象一下，自己那笨手笨脚的模样，忍不住想笑。
崔向阳可不乐意听这样的话，“叶婆婆，人可不能妄自菲薄，再说了，修炼也不止练剑，还有其他的嘛，你……你做饭好吃，说不定也能做个丹修呢！”
“你说得对。”
听到他提起丹修的事情，叶晚秋想到昨天夏景景过来的时候说他守着炼丹炉在炼丹，于是问：
“对了向阳，你拿丹药炼的如何了？顺利吗？”

“炼成了！”
崔向阳正发愁自己没有人可以炫耀呢，立马将怀里的小瓷瓶掏出来。
“叶婆婆你看！这个叫清明丸，是一种解毒的丹药，被迷惑的时候来上一颗，便可以耳清目明！”
“这么厉害？”
叶晚秋看着那药丸，和糖豆差不多大小，长得也差不多，但是有一种药材的香味。
“叶婆婆，你不懂，这药丸看上去和普通的丹药没什么区别，但是炼制起来极为困难，稍微把控不好火候，就变成毒药了！
那些丹修弟子入门好几年都炼制不出来这东西，而我崔向阳！从炼制这丹药开始，不过数月！”
他脸上写满了骄傲，嘴角的笑意压都压不住。
叶晚秋立马开口夸：“向阳你这剑修的好就罢了，这么难的丹药也能炼制出来，果然与普通人不一样！”
“咳咳！也没有，这品相也只能算是中等。”
崔向阳期待被人夸奖，可是这样的话到嘴边时，他又觉得有些不好意思了。
“中等不是挺好的吗？”叶晚秋还在继续夸，“这可是你第一次炼制出来的，就已经是中等的水平了，下一次岂不是可以做的更好？”
崔向阳：！！！
是啊！他怎么就没想到呢。
叶晚秋踮起脚，想摸摸孩子的头，但是这孩子身形实在是高大，她只能拍拍对方的肩膀。
content_en:
As Ye Wanqiu got older, she felt less sleepy and got up at dawn.
In the past, she would have to go to the vegetable market to buy the freshest vegetables and prepare breakfast for the whole family.
After arriving at this place, she didn't need to go to the vegetable market to fight with the group of old men and women to buy groceries, and she didn't need to worry about preparing breakfast of different flavors. When she was free, she didn't know what to do.
Ye Wanqiu recalled the radio gymnastics learned by his grandson, shouted slogans and did one himself.
After this man had nothing on his mind, he felt really refreshed.
I finished the last movement easily without even breaking a sweat.
"Okay!"
A voice sounded outside the yard, and Ye Wanqiu was startled.
She turned around and looked over and found that it was Cui Xiangyang.
"Grandma Ye, I think you should really test your spiritual roots. Maybe you have a talent for cultivation. Your body and bones are much better than those at the bottom of the mountain." Cui Xiangyang said.
He took Qingming Pills and was in a good mood.
I wanted to take the elixir to Elder Dan Xiu, but he was not there, so he probably went to look for the elixir elsewhere.
I wanted to go back to catch up on my sleep, so I walked to the small courtyard where Ye Wanqiu lived.
You’ve come here, how can you go back without having a meal?
Ye Wanqiu smiled sheepishly: "I just like to dance in the square. I am in better spirits than ordinary people. If you let me practice swordsmanship..."
She imagined her clumsiness in her mind and couldn't help but laugh.
Cui Xiangyang was not happy to hear such words, "Grandma Ye, you can't belittle yourself. Besides, cultivation is not just sword practice, there are other things as well. You... you cook well, maybe you can also be an alchemy practitioner!"
"You're right."
Hearing him mention the topic of alchemy cultivation, Ye Wanqiu thought of when Xia Jingjing came over yesterday and said that he was guarding the alchemy furnace and refining alchemy, so he asked:
"By the way, Xiangyang, how are you doing with the elixir? Did it go well?"
"It's finished!"
Cui Xiangyang was worried that he had no one to show off to, so he immediately took out the small porcelain bottle in his arms.
"Grandma Ye, look! This is called Qingming Pill. It is an antidote pill. When you are confused, take one and your ears and eyes will be clear!"
"So powerful?"
Ye Wanqiu looked at the pill. It was about the same size as a jelly bean and looked similar, but it had a medicinal fragrance.
"Grandma Ye, you don't understand. This pill looks no different from an ordinary pill, but it is extremely difficult to refine. If you don't control the heat well, it will turn into poison!
Those alchemy disciples who have been practicing for several years have not been able to refine this thing, but I, Cui Xiangyang! It only takes a few months to start refining this elixir! "
His face was full of pride, and he couldn't suppress the smile on his lips.
Ye Wanqiu immediately started to praise: "Xiang Yang, it's just that you are good at practicing the sword. You can also refine such a difficult elixir. It's really different from ordinary people!"
"Ahem! No, the quality can only be considered average."
Cui Xiangyang looked forward to being praised, but when such words came to his lips, he felt a little embarrassed.
"Isn't it good to be medium?" Ye Wanqiu continued to praise, "This is the first time you have refined it, so it is already at a medium level. Can't you do better next time?"
Cui Xiangyang:! ! !
yes! Why didn't he think of it?
Ye Wanqiu stood on tiptoes and wanted to touch the child's head, but the child was really tall, so she could only pat him on the shoulder.
